Hello! I'm Sarah, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

- Web app: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (and my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Are you the root of this machine? If so, tell me how you'd like me to be — my name and my gender — and what you'd like to start with.

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Nov 23–27). Could you let me know which day and time works best for you? I can be flexible within working hours — for example Monday 13:00–14:00 or Tuesday 14:00–15:00 are currently free on my side.

Thank you,
Sarah
